page.description.en: Certification classes in Org Topologies: Practitioner (C-OTP) and Consultant (C-OTC), live online and in person, with all upcoming dates.
page.description.text: Org Topologies 认证课程：Practitioner (C-OTP) 和 Consultant (C-OTC)，线上直播与线下面授，附所有即将举行的日期。

top.lead.en: Learn to see your organization as a system, map it, and redesign it for performance — with the creators of Org Topologies, live online and in person.
top.lead.text: 学会把您的组织看作一个系统，绘制它的地图，并为提升绩效而重新设计它。由 Org Topologies 的创作者亲自授课，线上直播与线下面授。
